tenderSchedule.title: Request for Proposal
tenderSchedule.description: Request for Proposal (RFP) Document for Selection of Solar Power Developer for Development, Installation, Operation & Maintenance of Rooftop solar photovoltaic power projects on Cluster-1 North Karnataka, 23 locations of newly constructed warehouses centers in various Part of Karnataka under PPP Mode based on Revenue Share

tenderAddress.blockNumber: UGRANA BHAVANA NO 43 PRIMROSE ROAD BANGALORE

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidders quotation should be in annual basis
All other terms and conditions as per the tender document.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have satisfactorily executed works of a similar nature for Government or Semi-Government or Public Sector Organizations Globally (provided power is supplied to the Government under PPP / EPC) during the last seven (7) years ending on the last day of the month preceding the one in which bids are invited.
Three similar completed works of minimum 21 MW (40% of 52 MW) each, any Solar power project
Two similar completed works of minimum 26 MW (50% of 52 MW) each, any Solar Power Project
One similar completed work of minimum 42 MW (80% of 52 MW) any Solar Power Project

The Bidder shall demonstrate Working Capital or Line of Credit equivalent to at least Rs.18,56,25,000 (Indian Rupees Eighteen Crore Fifty-Six Lakhs Twenty-Five Thousand only) for the last Financial Year, i.e., FY 2025/26.
3.Net Worth to be considered for this clause shall be the total Net Worth as calculated in accordance with the Companies Act 2013 and any further amendments thereto

The Bidder shall demonstrate a Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) of at least Rs.55,68,75,000 (Indian Rupees Fifty-Five Crore Sixty-Eight Lakhs Seventy-Five Thousand only) during the last three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2025/26, 2024/25, and 2023/24. It is clarified that Other Income shall not be considered for arriving at the annual turnover.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor s reports for the last five years
The Net Worth of the Bidder shall be equal to or greater than Rs.46,40,63,000 (Indian Rupees Forty-Six Crore Forty Lakh Sixty-Three Thousand only), as on 31.03.2026.

2. The net worth to be considered for the above purpose shall be the cumulative net worth of the Bidding Company or Consortium, together with the net worth of those Affiliates of the Bidder(s) that undertake to contribute the required equity funding and PBG in case the Bidder(s) fail to do so in accordance with the RFP.

Under this RFP, it is proposed to promote only commercially established and operational technologies to minimize the technology risk and to achieve timely commissioning of the Projects. The Bidder is required to undertake to furnish evidence of meeting the above criteria in line with provisions of the RFP. The undertaking shall be submitted as per enclosed Format 7.8.

It shall be mandatory for all prospective Bidders to visit and physically examine the identified warehouse premises/sites of KSWC, including the site conditions, surroundings, technical requirements, and local constraints, prior to submission of their Bid. The Bidder shall submit, along with the Technical Bid, a Site Visit Certificate in the format prescribed under Format 7.11 of this RFP, duly signed by the Executive Engineer, Karnataka State Warehousing Corporation (KSWC) Bangalore. Failure to submit/upload the duly certified Site Visit Certificate, shall result in rejection and technical disqualification of the Bid
All Technical criteria documents as per the tender document
List of Financial resources with certificate.
List of works for which tenders already submitted.
